package vm_test

import (
	"encoding/hex"
	"encoding/json"
	"math/big"
	"testing"

	"github.com/ethereum/go-ethereum/common"
	"github.com/ethereum/go-ethereum/core/rawdb"
	"github.com/harmony-one/harmony/core/state"
	"github.com/harmony-one/harmony/core/types"
	"github.com/harmony-one/harmony/core/vm"
	"github.com/harmony-one/harmony/hmy/tracers"
	_ "github.com/harmony-one/harmony/hmy/tracers/js"
	"github.com/harmony-one/harmony/internal/params"
)

func TestSupplyAuditRepeatedCXCall(t *testing.T) {
	disk := rawdb.NewMemoryDatabase()
	defer disk.Close()
	db, err := state.New(common.Hash{}, state.NewDatabase(disk), nil)
	if err != nil {
		t.Fatal(err)
	}
	origin := common.HexToAddress("0x1111")
	recipient := common.HexToAddress("0x2222")
	db.AddBalance(origin, big.NewInt(100))
	input := make([]byte, 100)
	copy(input, []byte{0x28, 0x48, 0x08, 0x00})
	input[35] = 100
	copy(input[48:68], recipient.Bytes())
	input[99] = 1
	var code []byte
	for offset := 0; offset < len(input); offset += 32 {
		word := make([]byte, 32)
		copy(word, input[offset:])
		code = append(code, byte(vm.PUSH32))
		code = append(code, word...)
		code = append(code, byte(vm.PUSH1), byte(offset), byte(vm.MSTORE))
	}
	// During construction the caller has no installed runtime code. The first
	// CALL creates the receipt; a zero-value duplicate is rejected and caught.
	for _, value := range []byte{100, 0} {
		code = append(code, 0x60, 0, 0x60, 0, 0x60, 100, 0x60, 0,
			0x60, value, 0x60, 0xf9, 0x61, 0x27, 0x10, byte(vm.CALL), byte(vm.POP))
	}
	code = append(code, byte(vm.STOP))
	tracer, err := tracers.New("callTracer", nil, nil)
	if err != nil {
		t.Fatal(err)
	}
	cfg := *params.MainnetChainConfig
	env := vm.NewEVM(vm.BlockContext{
		BlockNumber: big.NewInt(1), EpochNumber: big.NewInt(2000), Time: big.NewInt(1),
		ShardID: 0, NumShards: 2, TxType: types.SameShardTx,
		CanTransfer: func(db vm.StateDB, from common.Address, value *big.Int) bool {
			return db.GetBalance(from).Cmp(value) >= 0
		},
		Transfer: func(db vm.StateDB, from, to common.Address, value *big.Int, kind types.TransactionType) {
			if kind == types.SameShardTx || kind == types.SubtractionOnly {
				db.SubBalance(from, value)
			}
			if kind == types.SameShardTx {
				db.AddBalance(to, value)
			}
		},
		IsValidator: func(vm.StateDB, common.Address) bool { return false },
	}, vm.TxContext{Origin: origin, GasPrice: big.NewInt(0)}, db, &cfg, vm.Config{Debug: true, Tracer: tracer})
	_, created, _, err := env.Create(vm.AccountRef(origin), code, 1000000, big.NewInt(100))
	if err != nil {
		t.Fatal(err)
	}
	if env.CXReceipt == nil || env.CXReceipt.Amount.Cmp(big.NewInt(100)) != 0 || env.CXReceipt.From != created || *env.CXReceipt.To != recipient {
		t.Fatalf("unexpected receipt: %+v", env.CXReceipt)
	}
	for _, address := range []common.Address{origin, created, common.HexToAddress("0xf9")} {
		if db.GetBalance(address).Sign() != 0 {
			t.Fatalf("balance retained at %s: %s", address, db.GetBalance(address))
		}
	}
	result, err := tracer.GetResult()
	if err != nil {
		t.Fatal(err)
	}
	var trace struct {
		Error string
		Calls []struct {
			Error string
			To    string
		}
	}
	if err := json.Unmarshal(result, &trace); err != nil {
		t.Fatal(err)
	}
	if trace.Error != "" || len(trace.Calls) != 2 || trace.Calls[0].Error != "" || trace.Calls[1].Error == "" {
		t.Fatalf("unexpected trace: %s", result)
	}
	t.Logf("INIT_CODE=%s", hex.EncodeToString(code))
	t.Logf("TRACE=%s", result)
	t.Log("Real EVM result: success, source balance debited 100, one receipt 100, second precompile invocation rejected")
}
